latestVersion.changelog:
Audos 1.0.0

- Initial release: integrates with Audos API (v1.2) for fully autonomous AI-powered startup workspaces.
- Supports onboarding, authentication, workspace building, and status monitoring with detailed user progress updates.
- Provides live landing pages, custom brand identity, branded video, workspace OS, and AI assistant Otto for all new businesses.
- Includes specialized narration and guidance for each stage of the workspace build process.
- Returning users can resume workspaces instantly; new users verify via OTP email flow.
- Implements best-practice UX for polling, progress reporting, and user engagement during builds.
